Estonia narrows search for nuclear power plant location
articles.원문 요약: The search for a site for Estonia's first nuclear power plant will now focus on three locations, all in the municipality of Viru-Nigula, about 120 kilometres east of Tallin, after three locations in Lüganuse municipality were ruled out for security reasons.

articles.제목: Cernavodă units returning to operation after three months
articles.원문 요약: Nuclearelectrica and the Romanian government are working on long-term solutions to avoid a repeat of the Cernavodă units being shut down because of drought causing abnormally low water levels in the Danube.

articles.제목: Canadian budget sets out nuclear investments
articles.원문 요약: The budget released by the Canadian government provides funding for a strategy to double grid capacity by 2050, as well as investments in nuclear energy and critical minerals.

articles.제목: ASNR opens passive safety system testing facility
articles.원문 요약: France's nuclear safety regulator has inaugurated new research infrastructure and facilities at its Cadarache site for studying the reliability of passive safety systems. It aims to generate the scientific knowledge necessary for the independent safety assessment of innovative reactors and small modular reactors.

articles.제목: Concrete work completed for Akkuyu 4's turbine unit
articles.원문 요약: More than 2,240 cubic metres of concrete was used to complete the turbine building foundation for Turkey's Akkuyu Nuclear Power Plant's fourth unit.
